## 3.Data Visualization Questions
### 1.Create a bar chart showing the top 5 EV makes and models by count

top_makes = df['Make'].value_counts().head(5)

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
top_makes.plot(kind='bar')

plt.title('Top 5 EV Makes')
plt.xlabel('Make')
plt.ylabel('Number of Vehicles')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

plt.show()

top_models = df['Model'].value_counts().head(5)

plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
top_models.plot(kind='bar')

plt.title('Top 5 EV Models')
plt.xlabel('Model')
plt.ylabel('Number of Vehicles')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

plt.show()

Insight:

This chart identifies the most popular EV manufacturers and models in the dataset.
### 2.Use a heatmap or choropleth map to visualize EV distribution by county.

import seaborn as sns

county_counts = df['County'].value_counts().head(15)

heatmap_data = county_counts.to_frame()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))

sns.heatmap(
    heatmap_data,
    annot=True,
    fmt='g',
    cmap='YlGnBu'
)

plt.title('EV Distribution by County')

plt.show()
### 3.Create a line graph showing the trend of EV adoption by model year.

yearly_trend = (
    df['Model Year']
    .value_counts()
    .sort_index()
)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))

plt.plot(
    yearly_trend.index,
    yearly_trend.values,
    marker='o'
)

plt.title('EV Adoption Trend by Model Year')
plt.xlabel('Model Year')
plt.ylabel('Number of Vehicles')

plt.grid(True)

plt.show()

### 5.Plot a pie chart showing the proportion of CAFV-eligible vs. non-eligible EVs.

cafv_counts = (
    df['Clean Alternative Fuel Vehicle (CAFV) Eligibility']
    .value_counts()
)

plt.figure(figsize=(7,7))

plt.pie(
    cafv_counts,
    labels=cafv_counts.index,
    autopct='%1.1f%%'
)

plt.title('CAFV Eligibility Distribution')

plt.show()

Insight:

Shows the proportion of vehicles that qualify for government incentives.
### 6.Use a geospatial map to display EV registrations based on vehicle location.

df[['Longitude','Latitude']] = (
    df['Vehicle Location']
    .str.extract(
        r'POINT \(([-\d\.]+) ([-\d\.]+)\)'
    )
)

df['Longitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Longitude'])
df['Latitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Latitude'])

plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))

plt.scatter(
    df['Longitude'],
    df['Latitude'],
    alpha=0.3
)

plt.title('EV Registration Locations')
plt.xlabel('Longitude')
plt.ylabel('Latitude')

plt.show()
df.to_csv('EV-Data-Analysis.csv', index=False)
